Why FMH
Every day, someone receives a life-changing diagnosis. Getting the right medication should be straightforward - but too often it isn’t.

Specialty medications move through a complex network of providers, health plans, pharmacies, and manufacturers. Administrative delays, disconnected systems, and limited visibility can slow treatment when time matters most.

Free Market Health exists to make that process work better.

Our technology connects stakeholders across the specialty pharmacy ecosystem, helping prescriptions reach the right pharmacy while improving visibility, reducing friction, and keeping treatment moving forward for the patients who depend on them. We focus on the most important stakeholder of all: the patient.

Your impact

We are seeking a Senior Client Services Manager to serve as the primary day-to-day operational partner for assigned complex clients following implementation. In this highly visible role, you will lead client-facing operational execution, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, and ensure priorities, timelines, and deliverables remain aligned. Your work will directly influence service quality, client satisfaction, and retention.

You will own post-go-live operational coordination for key client relationships, facilitate complex projects across internal teams, and provide clear visibility into progress, risks, and outcomes. You will also help strengthen the Client Services team by mentoring newer colleagues and contributing to improved processes and service delivery.

WhatYou’llDo

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for director- and vice president-level client stakeholders.
  • Lead post-go-live operational projects and oversee client activity related to service delivery.
  • Develop and manage project plans, milestones, task logs, documentation, and recurring status updates.
  • Guide internal teams on priorities, resource needs, timelines, risks, and delivery expectations.
  • Evaluate project readiness for production based on scope, timing, quality, risk, and competing priorities.
  • Coordinate requirements and deliverables across internal partners to ensure work aligns with agreed-upon plans.
  • Manage benefit change requests and system configuration updates that support client and operational needs.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that strengthen efficiency, quality, and the client experience.
  • Train, mentor, and support newer or less experienced team members.

WhatWe’reLooking For

  • 7+ years of relevant industry experience, including specialty pharmacy experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in a client-facing role.
  • 2+ years of people management or team leadership experience.
  • Experience working for a pharmacy benefit manager (PBM).
  • Demonstrated success managing and delivering complex technical projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience applying established project management methodologies.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build effective relationships at all organizational levels.
  • Excellent organization, prioritization, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
  • A collaborative, adaptable approach and comfort navigating changing priorities and ambiguity.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, internet-based tools, and general PC applications.

Life at FMH

We’re building more than a company. We’re building a team of ambitious, curious people who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, growing their careers, and genuinely enjoying the journey together.

Based in Pittsburgh’s Strip District, FMH draws inspiration from the city we call home. Our value of Grit isn’t just a word on a wall. It’s a mindset inspired by the city around us: showing up, rolling up our sleeves, and finding a way forward no matter the challenge.

As FMH continues to grow, so do the opportunities for our people to leave their mark. Guided by our core values of Integrity, Adaptability, Grit, and Collaboration, we foster an environment where trust is earned, new ideas are welcomed, challenges are embraced, and success is shared. You will be surrounded by people who care deeply about the work they do and the people they do it with.

Together, we’re building something special, and we’re just getting started.

Benefit eligibility is based on employment status.  

Build What’s Next With Us

Healthcare is evolving - and so are we.

If you’re excited by meaningful challenges, collaborative teammates, and the opportunity to help build a growing healthcare technology company, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Title: Director, Global Content Production

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Director, Global Content Production

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role the Director, Global Content Production is responsible for operationalizing Amgen's content supply chain and leading the global production capability that delivers content at scale across brands, markets, and channels.

This leader oversees a global team and network of production partners responsible for delivering thousands of content production projects annually across web, CRM, Veeva, digital, print, localization, and omnichannel channels. The role is accountable for production quality, speed, compliance, cost efficiency, partner performance, and the successful adoption of automation and AI-enabled production capabilities.

Success in this role will be measured through improvements in production efficiency, cycle time reduction, content reuse, automation adoption, cost optimization, and the ability to scale content production globally.

Global Content Production Leadership

  • Lead a global team of production operations leaders across North America, Europe, and Asia responsible for production delivery and operational excellence.
  • Establish the operating model, governance framework, and service levels for the Global Content Production organization.
  • Build strategic partnerships across Content Excellence, Brand, Technology, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to align production capabilities with business needs.
  • Develop organizational capabilities and talent, fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Content Supply Chain Operations

  • Lead the delivery of thousands of content production projects annually across web, CRM, Veeva, print, localization, modular content, and omnichannel production services.
  • Ensure efficient, compliant, and high-quality content delivery through standardized workflows, resource planning, and production controls.
  • Drive operational consistency across regions, brands, and partners to improve speed, scalability, and stakeholder experience.
  • Define and monitor KPIs related to production speed, quality, compliance, cost, content reuse, capacity utilization, and stakeholder satisfaction.

Partner, Vendor & Financial Management

  • Oversee a global ecosystem of production agencies, creative partners, localization providers, and content operations vendors supporting content delivery at scale.
  • Manage production budgets, forecasting, and resource allocation to ensure cost-effective and efficient operations.
  • Establish vendor performance frameworks and governance processes to ensure partners meet quality, service, and business expectations.
  • Optimize external spend and partner performance while improving scalability and service delivery.

Automation, AI & Capability Evolution

  • Partner with Content Transformation and Technology teams to operationalize new production capabilities, workflows, and platforms.
  • Drive adoption of automation, modular content, and AI-enabled production solutions that improve productivity, quality, speed, and scalability.
  • Serve as a key business advocate for production technologies, helping maximize value realization from content supply chain and AI-enabled production platforms.
  • Identify and scale GenAI and automation use cases that increase content throughput, improve content reuse, and support business growth without proportional increases in cost or resources.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The content production professional we seek is a collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 4 years of experience in global content production operations, content supply chain management, and digital/omnichannel content delivery

OR

Master’s degree and 7 years of experience in global content production operations, content supply chain management, and digital/omnichannel content delivery

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of experience in global content production operations, content supply chain management, and digital/omnichannel content delivery

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills with a record of successful cross functional collaboration
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into action through detailed implementation plans
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to track executional performance and recommend improvements
  • Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to influence across levels
  • Experience working with agencies, operations teams, and brand teams in matrixed environments
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading change in evolving marketing environments
  • Familiarity with life sciences or regulated industries

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
